page.overview:
What is Dr. Terence Wynn?

Dr. Terence Wynn is a character who first appeared in the original . He later returned in .

Dr. Wynn is the secondary antagonist of the 4-6 Timeline, revealed to be the one who helped Michael Myers become a serial killer.

Dr. Wynn was the administrator of Smith's Grove Sanitarium. On October 31, 1978, he learned that Michael Myers had escaped and drove off to Haddonfield. Samuel Loomis and Wynn argued over how Michael easily escaped. Wynn says that Michael couldn't have gotten far because he can't drive. Ironically, Dr. Loomis says, "He was doing very well last night! Maybe, someone around here gave him lessons." Michael most likely taught himself to drive.

For more information, see Terence Wynn/4-6 Timeline
